slot.brief: Three words coded in different code strings; identify codes of common words by comparing letters across messages.

stem: In a certain code language, “ra ki mo” means “birds build nests”, “zu ki fe” means “children build kites”, and “ra do pa” means “birds fly high”. What is the code for “birds”?

verdicts.working: “ra” is the only code shared by the first and third phrases, whose only shared word is “birds”.

working:
“Birds” is the only word common to the first and third phrases; “ra” is the only code common to their strings. Thus birds = ra. The other options do not occur in both strings.

Independent check: “ra” is the only code shared by the first and third phrases, whose only shared word is “birds”.
solution: The first and third phrases share only the word “birds”; their only common code is “ra”. Hence, birds = ra.
